name: First Signal
story: A dormant relay wakes an Echo scout beneath the old transit arch.
tutorialBriefing:
Mara Venn, Arithmetist field unit. Same side as you.
Choose one of your numbers, then a different number from any living unit. Their sum wraps at 10 and replaces your first number. Try it, then strike the scout.
tutorialRule: TURN 01  /  Choose two numbers. Their sum becomes your first number.

name: Hold the Crossing
story: The relay route is blocked by a guard built to absorb every first blow.
tutorialBriefing: Good work. I have opened the field loadout. Equip a skill within the SP budget; it triggers automatically when its condition is met. I will draw the guard's attention while you test your new attack skill.
tutorialRule: LOADOUT  /  SP is your skill budget. Skills trigger automatically when their condition is met.

name: Silence the Echo
story: An Echo captain is restarting the relay. Mara holds the line as its backup signal begins to answer.
tutorialBriefing: The captain is protected by more than one Echo. Keep choosing targets and watch the field: reinforcements can arrive when an enemy falls. We end this together—the relay goes dark only when the whole hostile squad is cleared.
tutorialRule: FIELD  /  Defeat every enemy. Reinforcements may join before the encounter ends.
